items.q: How do I update my bank details for payroll?
items.a: Change them in the HR portal before the 20th of the month so the new account is used for that month's pay.

items.q: My account is locked. What should I do?
items.a:
Accounts lock after 5 failed sign-ins and unlock automatically after 15 minutes.
If you need access sooner, call the helpdesk and verify your identity.

items.q: How do I connect to the VPN?
items.a:
Open the VPN client, choose the nearest region and sign in with your work account and MFA.
The VPN is required for internal tools such as finance and HR systems.

items.q: The VPN keeps disconnecting. How can I fix it?
items.a:
Switch to a wired connection or a 5 GHz network, update the VPN client, and pick a closer region.
If it still drops every few minutes, send the client log to the helpdesk.

items.q: How do I request new software?
items.a:
Raise a software request in the service catalogue. Licensed tools need manager approval;
free tools on the approved list install automatically within one working day.

items.q: How do I set up email on my phone?
items.a:
Install the official mail app, sign in with your work account and accept the device policy.
Personal phones are supported if the screen lock is enabled.

items.q: How long does the helpdesk take to respond?
items.a: Urgent issues (nobody can work) within 1 hour; normal requests within 1 working day.
Use wired or 5 GHz Wi-Fi, update the client, pick a closer region.
